subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should GitHub Copilot native-search routing require provider-owned account/model capability with managed fallback, and should the resulting high-level helper become supported public Plugin SDK API?
rationale: Copilot accepts synthetic forward-compatible models while this PR infers hosted-search support from names and expands a public API; tests cannot decide the durable default or compatibility contract.

options.title: Capability-aware fallback
options.body: Carry verified Copilot native-search eligibility, retain managed search for unknown or unavailable cases, and expose only an approved high-level family helper.

options.title: Accept inferred eligibility
options.body: Keep regex-based routing only after exact-head live evidence covers supported and unsupported account/model cases and owners explicitly accept the risk.

options.title: Pause hosted search
options.body: Defer the feature if Copilot cannot expose a dependable capability and fallback contract.

recommendation.title: Capability-aware fallback
recommendation.body: Carry verified Copilot native-search eligibility, retain managed search for unknown or unavailable cases, and expose only an approved high-level family helper.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest merged history across Copilot behavior, native search, and the public Plugin SDK boundary affected by this decision.
